description: Explores distributed ledger technology, consensus algorithms, Ethereum smart contracts in Solidity, decentralized storage, and enterprise blockchain architectures.
learning_objectives: Understand cryptographic hash functions, digital signatures, and consensus protocols (PoW, PoS, PBFT).
Analyze blockchain platforms including Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Corda, and IPFS.
Develop, test, and deploy Solidity smart contracts and DApps using Web3 protocols.
Design enterprise blockchain applications in supply chain, DeFi, and AI data provenance.
outline: Blockchain Fundamentals: Distributed ledgers, cryptographic primitives, public-key cryptography, consensus protocols (PoW, PoS, PBFT, Raft).
Blockchain Platforms: Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, Corda, Ripple, IPFS decentralized storage.
Smart Contract Development: Solidity programming, contract lifecycle, events, security vulnerabilities (reentrancy, overflows), Web3.js.
Decentralized Applications (DApps): Token standards (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155), decentralized finance (DeFi), oracle networks (Chainlink).
Enterprise Applications: Supply chain tracking, healthcare data sharing, digital identity, AI-Blockchain integration.
